name: XOCP
install: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && bun install

terminals.name: Web UI (HMR)
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" && sleep 2 && bun run --cwd packages/app dev -- --port 4444 --host 0.0.0.0
